title: Design System: ECHO — Voice-First AI Tutor

display.purpose: Hero and section headings, brand wordmark only.

body.purpose: Body, UI labels, buttons, nav, data, chat.

shadows.name: clay-inset
shadows.purpose: Recessed pills and badges that sit into the surface.

motion.name: ease-clay
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and lift/press.

motion.name: mic-pulse
motion.purpose: Listening mic pulse: scale 1 -> 1.08 with expanding red ring.

components.name: Clay Button (Primary)
components.description: Lavender pill CTA with the small clay shadow; presses in on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#6B5E88; color:#F5F3EF; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:16px; padding:14px 32px; border:none; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.70); box-shadow:8px 8px 16px rgba(40,38,34,0.22), -8px -8px 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.78), inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset -2px -4px 6px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow:10px 10px 20px rgba(40,38,34,0.26), -10px -10px 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset -2px -4px 6px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); box-shadow:inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.78), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(40,38,34,0.10), 2px 2px 4px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #A898C0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Clay Card (Neutral)
components.description: Warm-grey clay surface, 32px radius, glazed white edge.
components.html:
Ask anything

Talk to your tutor in your own language.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#EAE8E4; border-radius:32px; padding:32px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.70); box-shadow:16px 16px 32px rgba(40,38,34,0.28), -16px -16px 32px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset 4px 4px 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset -4px -4px 12px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:20px; color:#1A1714; margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; color:#6B6560; margin:0; }

components.name: Clay Pill (Recessed)
components.description: Inset/recessed label or filter pill that sits into the surface.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.02em; color:#6B5E88; background:#EAE8E4; padding:7px 16px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.78), inset -2px -2px 6px rgba(40,38,34,0.10), 2px 2px 4px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); }

components.name: Claymic Tutor Button
components.description: Voice entry point: 44x44 clay circle, pulses red while listening. The one saturated control.
components.html: <button class="ds-mic" aria-label="Talk to your tutor"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#F5F3EF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0"/><line x1="12" y1="18" x2="12" y2="21"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-mic { width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.70); background:#6B5E88; color:#F5F3EF; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:8px 8px 16px rgba(40,38,34,0.22), -8px -8px 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.78), inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.82), inset -2px -4px 6px rgba(40,38,34,0.10); transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-mic:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-mic:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #A898C0; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-mic.listening { background:#dc2626; animation:ds-mic-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-mic-pulse { 0%,100% { transform:scale(1); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(220,38,38,0.4);} 50% { transform:scale(1.08); box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(220,38,38,0);} }

narrative.overview: ECHO's visual language holds claymorphism and minimalism in tension: tactile, puffy, three-dimensional surfaces from layered light-and-dark shadows, against a restrained, desaturated palette and generous whitespace. Warm and trustworthy for children and parents without slipping into toy-like loudness. The interface meets a child in their own language (12 Indian languages, Urdu RTL-aware) and honors spoken input, so type stays legible and uncluttered; a watching parent reads calm competence. Depth comes from shadow and glaze, never from saturation. The live codebase currently ships a divergent teal + yellow theme; this file documents the intended Claymorphism x Minimalism brand system.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile clay surfaces (four-layer neumorphic shadow + glazed white edge), never flat.
Desaturated accent palette — color that reads without competing.
Warm off-white base (#EAE8E4), not pure white, not cream/beige AI-default.
Fraunces display + Plus Jakarta Sans body; display reserved for hero/section headings, not UI labels.
Generous radius (32px cards, 999px pills); soft, not sharp.

rules.name: The Desaturated Voice Rule
rules.body: Accents stay at the muted tones. Never promote a tint to a full-saturation CTA or use saturated hue for an inactive state; saturation is reserved for the live mic and active selection.

rules.name: The One Warm Base Rule
rules.body: Page background is #EAE8E4 (or its tinted blobs), never pure white and never the cream/sand AI default.

rules.name: The Display-Stays-Hero Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for hero/section headings and the brand wordmark only. Buttons, nav, form controls, data, and chat use Plus Jakarta Sans.

rules.name: The Language-First Rule
rules.body: Every string is localized (12 languages). Urdu is RTL — layout, alignment, and icon direction must flip. Never hard-code English or LTR-only spacing.

rules.name: The Glazed Edge Rule
rules.body: Every lifted clay surface gets a 1px translucent-white border. No clay component ships without it.

rules.name: The Press-In Rule
rules.body: Interactive clay elements invert their shadow and scale to 0.97 on :active. Hover may lift; active always presses.

dos: Do build depth with the four-layer clay shadow + glazed white edge on every lifted surface.
Do keep accents desaturated; let saturation appear only on the live mic and active selection.
Do use Fraunces for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere else.
Do preserve visible focus outlines and a 44x44px minimum touch target.
Do support the three accessibility modes and Urdu RTL out of the box.
Do keep the free experience complete; show Premium as a fair optional step up.
donts: Don't make it toy-like or loud — no candy colors that make a parent distrust it.
Don't lead with a cluttered SaaS feature grid or upsell badges; show the tutoring.
Don't treat English as the default — every surface must be language-first; Urdu must flip RTL.
Don't build a cold, neon, dashboard-for-engineers look.
Don't flatten clay surfaces, drop the glazed border, or strip outline for 'clean'.
Don't use a display serif on buttons, nav, form controls, or data.
Don't use pure white or the cream/sand AI-default as the page background.
Don't ship a component with only some states.
